text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Today's tone is even more vago,
yet somehow pesante...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How strange? A somewhat plumper Toni...
While delightfully voluptuous in its own right...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That's not the sound I was aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Is there an issue with the violin...
No, nothing's wrong with it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is the fingertips, and... the cheeks, but...
Could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
No wonder...
The melody of the Fairy's Waltz sounded just like sumo wrestlers grappling...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ciao! Trainer.
Looking as dashing and lovely as ever today."
choice_data_list: A marathon on your day off?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, putting on just a little weight
has changed the sound of my violin, you see."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The body is part of the instrument.
To play the ideal melody,
you've gotta take proper care of it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And having stoically continued his running regimen,
Sounds of Earth successfully
managed to lose weight.
